_viewpoint_comment: Which camera the ghost overlay is reprojected through. 'head_tracked' = camera rides the avatar's pan/tilt head, pose recomputed each tick from HeadStateMsg (needs a head device on the avatar). 'static' = fixed camera, pose constant; pos/look_at use the same convention as a MuJoCo 'type: fixed' camera so they copy straight out of the sim scene config. Both sub-blocks are always parsed, so switching scenarios is a one-word edit to 'mode'. Swap this whole file via config.json for a different scenario (see overlay_desk.json).
_capture_fov_comment: HORIZONTAL FOV of the video camera in degrees. MuJoCo specifies cameras by VERTICAL fovy, so convert: hfov = 2*atan(tan(fovy/2) * width/height). Head cams are fovy=60 at 1280x960 -> 2*atan(tan(30)*4/3) = 75.2. A wrong value keeps the overlay aligned at the image centre while it drifts toward the edges, which looks like a calibration error.
_quad_comment: Face-locked quad geometry, shared by the ghost overlay layer AND the video layer (and read by gaze projection). One source of truth on purpose: if these diverge the ghost slides off the image it annotates and gaze mistargets. hmd_hfov_deg is the headset's horizontal FOV -- ~110 for Vive Pro / Pro Eye.
